scheme_name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Assistance to Enroll and Participate for Acceleration Program
other_conditions: Must have an innovative idea or concept
Must be recommended by an approved Nodal Institution
Open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc.
Startups receiving benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹3,00,000 for startups to enroll in acceleration programs.
